To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

“e learning is an educational approach that allows the student to learn in an online environment, with a focus on the use of technology and the development of skills that can be applied in the real world”.
the use of technology in education can be a valuable tool to enhance learning, but it is not the only solution for improving education.
e learning can be defined as a process of learning through online tools, which are designed for students and teachers in education.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the use of e learning in educational contexts and the impact of e learning on the learning process.
the analysis of e learning in the context of education.
the development of a systematic review of the literature on e learning and the identification of the main research trends in the last decade.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
e learning is a learning process that uses online technologies to support and enhance the learning process.
e learning has been used as a tool for education and training, but it is not a substitute for traditional learning methods, and it should be used as a complementary tool for education.
the e learning is a process of learning and teaching that uses electronic media, technology, and the internet to deliver educational information to students.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
e learning is a learning system in which students and teachers interact with online learning tools to improve their educational outcomes.

e learning is a new learning environment that can be accessed from any device and any place, anytime, anywhere, and with anyone, and it is based on learning and teaching activities that are supported by technology and that can be accessed by students and teachers.
this study is a useful tool for researchers and practitioners who are interested in e learning in the education field.
The main takeaway from our work is that
e learning has a significant impact on learning, and it is a key component of the educational system.
e learning is a process in which the student is the protagonist of his/her own learning experience, which is supported by a system of online learning tools.
the use of e learning systems can have a positive impact on students’ learning and behaviour, and can also be a useful tool to improve education systems.
